items.title: Beijing seeks to bolster AI shares
items.summary: After recent sharp drops for some Chinese tech stocks, Beijing is trying to prop them up -- seeing the sector, and in particular AI, as a central strategic priority.On Tuesday, net capital inflows into nine exchange-traded funds (ETFs), commonly used by Beijing to prop up the market, reached 120 billion yuan ($18 billion) -- a near-record, according to Bloomberg data, targeting tech stocks in particular.
